info.description: Backend API for CivicConnect v2 (design section 51A contract)

get.description:
§51A.17 readiness: required dependencies (database, object storage) must work; Redis is optional infrastructure and is reported as ``degraded`` when absent.
``vector_search`` says whether pgvector similarity search is available (optional, never affects readiness). The body contains no citizen data.

post.description: §51A.2 (additive: ``password`` is required because ``/auth/login`` is password based).
OAuth2 form login: the 'Authorize' button of the interactive docs (username = email or phone).
Records the authorized human triage decision; a decision that differs from the stored AI recommendation is audited as an AI override.

get.description: §51A.13 aggregate operational metrics for the caller's scope (staff: their scope; overlooker: whole city, aggregates only).
Cases created per day or ISO week (Monday, UTC) by category and status, plus created / resolved / critical totals per bucket. Grouped in SQL, scoped to the caller's role.
A07: incoming and resolved over the last ``days`` days, median resolution, SLA compliance, open workload by severity, backlog age, reopened, recurring cases.
A09: per ward cases, open, critical, backlog, median resolution days, recurring sites and the category distribution.

AnalyticsExplainResponse.title: AnalyticsExplainResponse
AnalyticsExplainResponse.description: Numbers come from ``facts`` (deterministic); ``summary``/``highlights`` only explain them and are verified against them (``grounded``).

CasePatch.title: CasePatch
CasePatch.description: Only the fields the caller's role may change are accepted; anything else is refused with FIELD_NOT_PERMITTED.
